dialogue.origin: （本日はよろしくお願い致します。定刻になりましたら始めさせていただきます。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for joining us today. We will begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.origin: （こちらこそ、よろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you as well. I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。今日はご相談ありがとうございます。最初に、年齢、性別、相談内容を教えて下さい。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for reaching out today. First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 15さい　女　生きてるのがつらい
dialogue.content: 15 years old, female. It's painful to be alive.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただきありがとうございます。生きてるのがおつらい状況なんですね。詳しく教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. It sounds like you're in a really tough situation where living feels painful. Could you tell me more about it?

dialogue.origin: 敬語使うと話しにくいから、タメ語にして
dialogue.content: It's hard to talk formally, so can we speak casually?

dialogue.origin: 死にたい　自殺したい
dialogue.content: I want to die. I want to kill myself.

dialogue.origin: ではタメ語でお話させていただきますね。
dialogue.content: Okay, let's speak casually then.

dialogue.origin: ありがとう
dialogue.content: Thanks.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとう。どうして死にたいと思うようになったの？よかったら聞かせてくれる？
dialogue.content: Thank you, too. What made you start feeling like you want to die? If you're okay with it, could you tell me?

dialogue.origin: 学校でいじめられてる
dialogue.content: I'm being bullied at school.

dialogue.origin: それはつらいね。。いつからいじめられてるの？
dialogue.content: That must be really tough... How long has the bullying been going on?

dialogue.origin: 小学校のときからずっと
dialogue.content: Ever since elementary school.

dialogue.origin: 昨日つらすぎてリスカした
dialogue.content: Yesterday it was so painful that I cut myself.

dialogue.origin: 首もしめたけど死ねなかった
dialogue.content: I also tried to strangle myself, but I couldn't die.

dialogue.origin: リスカして血は止まった？よっぽどつらい気持ちがあるんだね。
dialogue.content: After you cut yourself, did the bleeding stop? You must be feeling incredibly distressed.

dialogue.origin: 血はだいじょうぶ
dialogue.content: The bleeding's okay.

dialogue.origin: よかった！！なにかいじめのキッカケのようなことはあったの？
dialogue.content: That's a relief! Was there anything that triggered the bullying?

dialogue.origin: わかんない
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: わたしが邪魔なんだと思う
dialogue.content: I think I'm in the way.

dialogue.origin: 自分が邪魔だと考えてるんだね。どうして邪魔だと思うの？
dialogue.content: You feel like you're in the way, huh. Why do you think that?

dialogue.origin: わかんない
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: けどみんな邪魔だからいじめるんでしょ
dialogue.content: But everyone bullies me because I'm in the way, right?

dialogue.origin: どんな子たちからいじめられてるの？
dialogue.content: What kind of kids are bullying you?

dialogue.origin: 男の子たち
dialogue.content: The boys.

dialogue.origin: 男の子たちなんだね。どんな風にいじめられてるの？
dialogue.content: It's the boys, huh. How are they bullying you?

dialogue.origin: みんなが見えない場所で叩かれたり蹴られたりする
dialogue.content: They hit and kick me where no one can see.

dialogue.origin: それは痛いし怖いよね。。
dialogue.content: That must be painful and scary...

dialogue.origin: 今までに先生や両親に話したことはある？
dialogue.content: Have you ever talked to a teacher or your parents about it?

dialogue.origin: ない
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: 両親はいない
dialogue.content: I don't have parents.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか。今はだれと一緒に暮らしているの？
dialogue.content: I see, I see. Who are you living with now?

dialogue.origin: 施設で暮らしてる
dialogue.content: I live in a group home.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。施設の人にも話したことはない？
dialogue.content: I understand. Have you told anyone at the home?

dialogue.origin: ない
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: 誰にも言ったことない
dialogue.content: I haven't told anyone.

dialogue.origin: 一人で誰にも相談せずに悩んでいたんだね。
dialogue.content: So you've been struggling with this all by yourself without talking to anyone.

dialogue.origin: うん　だからもう死にたい
dialogue.content: Yeah. That's why I just want to die.

dialogue.origin: 不安だったよね。今まで誰にも相談せずにいたのはなにか思いがあるの？
dialogue.content: You must have felt very anxious. Was there a reason you hadn't talked to anyone until now?

dialogue.origin: 我慢すれば良いと思ってたから
dialogue.content: Because I thought I just needed to endure it.

dialogue.origin: 我慢すればいいと思っていたんだね。それでも勇気を持ってこの相談に来てくれたんだね。
dialogue.content: You thought you just had to endure it. And yet, you gathered the courage to come and talk to me today.

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 話してくれてありがとう。今まで誰にも相談せず我慢していたけど、こうやって人に話してみてどう思った？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing. You've been enduring this without telling anyone—how does it feel to talk about it with someone?

dialogue.origin: 助けてほしい
dialogue.content: I want help.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね。すごくその気持ち伝わるよ。今まで我慢してきたけど、それでもすごくつらい状況は変わってないと思うから、
dialogue.content: I understand. I can really feel that from you. You've been enduring this for so long, but the painful situation hasn't changed, so,

dialogue.origin: 身近な先生や施設の人に今のその気持ちを話してみるのはどうかな？
dialogue.content: how about talking to a teacher nearby or someone at the group home about how you're feeling?

dialogue.origin: 学校最近ほとんど行けてないんだよね
dialogue.content: I haven't been able to go to school much lately.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか。その時間は施設にいるの？
dialogue.content: I see, I see. Are you at the group home during that time?

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 施設でよくお話する大人の人とかはいる？
dialogue.content: Is there an adult at the home you talk to often?

dialogue.origin: ほとんどいないかな
dialogue.content: Not really.

dialogue.origin: いないかぁ。。身近で気にかけてくれてる人とかに相談しみるとかどうかな？
dialogue.content: No one, huh... What about talking to someone nearby who seems to care about you?

dialogue.origin: 誰もいないんだよね
dialogue.content: There's no one.

dialogue.origin: そっかぁ。。そろそろお時間だけど、こうやって人に相談してみてどう感じたかな？
dialogue.content: I see... Our time is almost up, but how did you feel talking to someone like this?

dialogue.origin: 死にたいと思ってたけど少し楽になった
dialogue.content: I wanted to die, but I feel a little lighter.

dialogue.origin: 少しでも楽になってもらえてよかった。人に話してみるのも、楽になるキッカケになるから、もしこの人だったら話してみてもいいなぁって思える人ができたら少しでも話してみてね。もちろんここにはいつでも相談しにきてくれていいので、また待ってるね。
dialogue.content: I'm glad you feel even a little better. Talking to someone can be a way to start feeling better, so if you find someone you feel you can talk to, try talking to them, even just a little. Of course, you can always come back here to talk anytime, so I'll be waiting for you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとう
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ勇気を持って相談しに来てくれてありがとう。では失礼するね。
dialogue.content: Thank you for having the courage to come and talk to me. I'll sign off now.

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: それでは失礼します。
dialogue.content: Goodbye then.

dialogue.origin: （少し時間過ぎてしまい失礼しました。本日はマッチングありがとうございました。非常に勉強になりました）
dialogue.content: (I apologize for going a little over time. Thank you for the session today. It was a great learning experience.)

dialogue.origin: （ロープレお疲れさまでした。こちらこそ勉強になりました。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Good work on the role-play. It was a learning experience for me as well. Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: （それでは失礼致します）
dialogue.content: (Well then, goodbye.)
